category_edits.rationale: Across all four datasets, halve the training-frequency feature amplitude to reduce popularity distortion while retaining its context cue. Existing checkpointed scales ensure consistent inference; padding and mask scales remain one. Preserve embeddings, topology, readout, loss and optimizer.

change_summary: Reduce training-frequency input modulation from 0.04 to 0.02 for all four category models. The existing predictor loads the checkpointed feature buffer without changes.
